table.name: TLGNC_PICKUP_LOADINGPOINT
table.description: Mapping between a client attribute and loadingpoint terminals. Used for the touchscreen terminals located at the loadingpoints.

column.name: CLIENT_IDENTIFIER
column.description: Current implementation uses host name to look up the loadingpoint.

column.name: LOADINGPOINT_ID
column.description: FK. The id of the loadingpoint where the touchscreen terminal stands.

column.name: ORDERS_LOADABLE_TERMINAL_FLAG
column.description: Defines whether or not loading of Bag materials can be performed on the Terminal (using Terminal App.). If the flag is activated (1=activated), the loading will be possible on the Terminal, if it is deactivated (0=deactivated) loading will NOT happen on the Terminal (loading will be performed with LDS or LOGON).

column.name: BULK_PICKUP_CREATION_FLAG
column.description: This flag defines whether or not Bulk Pickup orders are AVAILABLE and can be CREATED on the Terminal Application.
